intro: LLM agents fail in categorically different ways than LLM completions. Hallucination is one of many. Below: twelve named failure modes with cause, detection signal, and mechanical fix. This taxonomy is the index — every other module's pitfalls are instances of these.

items.title: Infinite loop
items.whenToUse: Detect: same tool called with identical args N+ times.
items.mechanism: Cause: tool returns ambiguous result, model retries same approach. Detect: deduplicate signature of (tool_name, JSON.stringify(args)); count repeats.
items.tradeoff: Fix: on N=3 repeat, surface to model as a tool error ('you've called X three times with same args — try a different approach') and force a different action.

items.title: Premature stop
items.whenToUse: Model emits end_turn with the sub-task incomplete.
items.mechanism: Cause: model judges 'done' on inadequate evidence. Detect: validate final output against task contract (schema, expected fields, length floor).
items.tradeoff: Fix: on validation failure, push the validator's error as a tool_result and force another loop turn. Equivalent to Reflexion-lite.

items.title: Tool hallucination (unknown tool)
items.whenToUse: Model calls a tool that does not exist.
items.mechanism: Cause: tool name was in training data or 'feels right'. Detect: name not in registry.
items.tradeoff: Fix: return tool_result with is_error: true and explicit message 'Unknown tool. Available tools: X, Y, Z.' Model self-corrects.

items.title: Arg hallucination
items.whenToUse: Real tool called with invented argument values (made-up ids, wrong enum, fake user_id).
items.mechanism: Cause: model confabulates plausible-looking ids. Detect: schema validation at the handler boundary; semantic checks (does the id exist?).
items.tradeoff: Fix: structured error envelope back; never silently coerce.

items.title: Context poisoning
items.whenToUse: Tool result reshapes model behavior in unintended ways.
items.mechanism: Cause: indirect prompt injection (Module J). Detect: delimited untrusted content + an output validator catching unexpected actions.
items.tradeoff: Fix: defense-in-depth from Module J. No single mitigation suffices.

items.title: Goal drift
items.mechanism: Cause: original task gets displaced by accumulated tool results. Detect: at each turn, the model is asked to restate the goal; deviation flagged.
items.tradeoff: Fix: pin the goal at the END of each user-message slot (recency bias). Or: subagent delegation (Module L) for sub-tasks.

items.title: Over-eager hand-off
items.mechanism: Cause: agent A passes to B at the first sign of out-of-domain, when A could have handled it. Detect: handoff rate by category; compare to expert routing baseline.
items.tradeoff: Fix: tighten hand-off criteria in agent A's prompt; add a 'try first, hand off only if stuck' clause.

items.title: Under-eager hand-off
items.mechanism: Cause: specialist refuses to delegate even when out of scope. Detect: low handoff rate + low task success on out-of-domain queries.
items.tradeoff: Fix: add explicit hand-off targets and triggers to the system prompt. 'When the question is about X, hand to expert_X.'

items.title: Truncation cascade
items.whenToUse: Tool returns oversized payload, gets cut, model answers from partial.
items.mechanism: Cause: tool result truncated silently. Detect: hash before/after at the truncation boundary; mark explicitly.
items.tradeoff: Fix: '[truncated: N more chars]' marker is mandatory. Provide a paginate-via-tool affordance for the model to ask for more.

items.title: Parse-and-retry storm
items.mechanism: Cause: schema too complex, or model output drifts. Detect: retry counter exceeds threshold.
items.tradeoff: Fix: cap retries (2). On final failure, surface the error verbatim. Investigate the schema — usually the cure is schema simplification.

items.title: Tool result swallowing
items.whenToUse: Model ignores tool result and hallucinates instead.
items.mechanism: Cause: tool result format unfamiliar to the model, or system prompt overrides 'cite tool results'. Detect: response asserts facts not in the tool_result.
items.tradeoff: Fix: include 'Always cite the tool result by name when stating a fact retrieved via a tool' in system prompt. Validate citations programmatically.

items.title: Schema confusion
items.whenToUse: Two tools with overlapping descriptions or schemas.
items.mechanism: Cause: model picks randomly between near-duplicates. Detect: tool selection variance on identical inputs.
items.tradeoff: Fix: consolidate tools. Sharpen descriptions (when-to-use-this-over-that). See Module G.

pitfalls.title: Treating agent failures as LLM bugs
pitfalls.body: Most agent failures are HARNESS bugs. Better tools, better schemas, better budgets fix them — not better prompts or bigger models.

pitfalls.title: Debugging without traces
pitfalls.body: Without full traces (every step, every tool call, every arg), you cannot classify what failed. Build the trace stack first; debug second.

pitfalls.title: Fixing the symptom
pitfalls.body: Adding 'don't loop' to the system prompt is not a fix for infinite loops. The fix is in the harness (loop detector). Match the fix to the mode.

pitfalls.title: Lumping all failures into 'agent didn't work'
pitfalls.body: Your eval needs to classify failure mode. 'It failed' is not actionable; 'it tool-hallucinated on 12% of cases' is.
